Two existing rows encode the behaviour the ruling replaces and must change with the fix: e2e/threads.e2e.ts, `a session retraction leaves its reason on the card and removes the human's live inbox item @phone`, which reloads the Inbox before asserting the row is gone (its `if (hasReadingPane(inboxPage))` branch), and e2e/close-withdraws-asks.e2e.ts's `expectWithdrawn`, which reloads for the same reason.
